title: sanguisorba minor var. megacarpa
intro: Sanguisorba minor var. megacarpa, commonly known as the dwarf burning bush or large-fruited burnet, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the rose family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and hemostatic properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, ulcers, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Sanguisorba minor var. megacarpa include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
